summary: Actual is a self-hosted personal finance application that uses a zero-sum budgeting model to help you manage your money. It supports manual transaction imports alongside optional automatic bank synchronization and device syncing.
goodFor: It suits individuals wanting local-first control over their personal budgeting data without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: Setting up automatic bank synchronization can require external configuration and API integrations depending on your financial institutions.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based Node.js application, you will typically need to configure persistent volume storage for your financial data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
